review:
Hot Rocket Mega Potz is the next chapter of the Rocket Eruption series, with 4,096 ways and a tropical jungle setting. New features include multiplier rewards based on how many spins you've played, bonus triggers via a special reel, and a free spins pre-game.

A special symbol that pays anywhere activates its reel and lights a fire in the beast's mouth beneath it. Free spins or a red-volcano bonus can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 6,030x maximum. The RTP is 94.15%, lower than most BGaming releases. The bonus arrives about once every 250 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
